BETA Close X Bellway PLC has executed a share buyback program, purchasing a total of 300,800 ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange between May 11th and May 15th, 2026. The volume-weighted average price for these purchases was 1,899.33 pence per share, with the highest price paid being 1,969.00 pence and the lowest at 1,835.00 pence. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, and following their cancellation, the Group's total issued ordinary shares will be 114,968,351. Disclaimer* Bellway PLC 18 May 2026 Bellway p.l.c. Transaction in Own Shares 18 May 2026 Bellway p.l.c. ('Bellway' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the 'Buyback Programme') announced on 14 October 2025 and the terms of the Second Tranche announced on 2 April 2026, from 11 May 2026 up to and including 15 May 2026 the Group purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 12.5 pence each (the Ordinary Shares') through Deutsche Bank AG. Date Number of shares purchased Highest price paid (GBp) Lowest price paid (GBp) Volume weighted average price (GBp) Trading venue 11 May 2026 51,000 1,969.00 1,944.00 1,957.21 XLON 12 May 2026 51,800 1,945.00 1,913.00 1,924.93 XLON 13 May 2026 66,000 1,902.00 1,858.00 1,879.61 XLON 14 May 2026 65,000 1,915.00 1,885.00 1,897.10 XLON 15 May 2026 67,000 1,878.00 1,835.00 1,857.08 XLON The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Second Tranche of the Buyback Programme on 2 April 2026, Bellway has purchased 1,368,747 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation. Bellway has now purchased 4,327,063 Ordinary Shares under the first and second tranche (to date) in aggregate for cancellation under the Buyback Programme. Following settlement of the above purchases and cancellation of the purchased ordinary shares, the Group's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 114,968,351 ordinary shares. In accordance with Article 5(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 as it applies in the UK (the Market Abuse Regulation), the table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Deutsche Bank AG on behalf of Bellway as part of the Buyback Programme.
